reasons: **Heat is right at the edge.** This plan finishes about half of the most important work, but it keeps crew body heat just barely under the safe limit, with almost no room to spare. If it turns out hotter than forecast or anyone looks unwell, cut back right away.

**Everyone comes inside from 1 to 3 PM.** Lightning and severe storms are expected, so no outdoor work during that window. Kofi is new and not used to the heat yet, so keep him off the hardest jobs while it's hot.

**Other options trade work for safety.** One plan gets the same amount done but runs the crew slightly hotter. Another keeps the crew cooler but gets less done (about 4 in 10 tasks instead of half). This plan sits between them.

Hard safety rules:
- Every worker's 90th percentile core temperature must stay below 38.0 °C all shift. Harder work, sun and high WBGT heat people up; 30-min shade rests cool them down.
- Breaks: at most 3 work slots in a row, then a 'rest' slot; at most 2 in a row if any of those slots has WBGT >= 30.0 °C.
- No outdoor tasks during hazards that stop outdoor work. After lightning, outdoor work stays stopped for 30 more minutes.
- Workers who are not acclimatized never do very_heavy tasks when WBGT >= 28.0 °C.
Validity: one entry per slot per worker; off-site workers rest; skills and allowed slots must match.
